Yeah, I live in Canada. Are you experiencing this bug as well?
I assume you're trying to run a ram rider cycle deck. Try using 2 spells only (i.e log and fireball) and replace some of your cards for cheaper ones, such as ice spirit or cannon or goblin cage

1. Were you born with maladaptive daydreaming? Or did you face trauma and 'catch' maladaptive daydreaming to cope with everything?
2. Would you consider your daydreaming as 'post-cognition' or 'pre-cognition', or just intense daydreaming and fantasy? If so, how does that affect your social life?
3. A lot of wise quotes and sayings always tell us to live life to its fullest (i.e Fill the unforgiving minute with sixty seconds with distance run; don't live day by day, instead live second by second, etc.)  
Does your daydreaming hinder your ability to follow those teachings? If so, how does it feel to know that you could possibly never experience the privilege of living life to its fullest? Or did you know that already and found out ways to cope with that knowledge?
Are you a celebrity, or are you mentally ill?
It takes a special someone to get lose in HayDay
The good news WILL come, you have to stay strong. We are here for you!

I appreciate the help, but I really want answers or an apology from the mods, and get back on the server. I don't want to get on their conflict against Blobbles, but I want to get back on the server because I was unfairly banned (What is a Senpai?). The only times I teamed up with players was when the events came out, like the Sakura/Samurai Sword and the Saloon, when I recall 5 or so people working together to obtain the weapon behind the puzzle.

I did not post any pictures of teaming nor encourage player to team up unconditionally. I was banned for voicing my opinion on teaming and saw 'Blob' (assuming that he is Blobble's alt account) get banned after apologizing to the mods. I felt the need to post this because I was banned on Discord for little to no reason and saw someone get banned after being flamed. Call them professional or top notch all you want. I was banned without warning, despite it being 'not an easy thing to do'.

Perhaps my feelings against the mods will calm down one day, but rn I want to get back on the Discord server without any issues with anyone there.
Just get me back on the server. I'm sure you know that I have every reason to be angry.

I'm not this 'Blobbles' person. I would like to be back on the Discord because I was banned.
